module sirv_AsyncResetReg (
                      input      d,
                      output reg q,
                      input      en,

                      input      clk,
                      input      rst);
   
   always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin

      if (rst) begin
         q <= 1'b0;
      end else if (en) begin
         q <= d;
      end
   end
   

endmodule

endmodule
